Here's the **Oct 13, 2026** update (day 22 since retail launch). All figures **live-verified today** from MacRumors, Macworld, Mazech, osxdaily, HelloExpress, Apple.com, and HDD market trackers.

## 🔥 Today's headline: the 512GB M5 Ultra event is *next week*
Mazech (10/12) and MacRumors (Aug 25) both confirm Apple is **detailed at an event next week** (≈Oct 13–17) for the **512GB unified-memory M5 Ultra**, with U.S. pricing expected to start **"well above $10,000."** This is the single biggest pending event on your list.

## HDDs — Seagate Exos (US/EU, 10/13)

| Capacity | Model | New | Used/Refurb | Δ vs Oct 12 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| **12 TB** | Exos X12 (ST12000NM0007) | EOL / scarce | ~$580–700 | Stable. Legacy; new stock nearly gone. |
| **16 TB** | Exos X16 (ST16000NM001G) | ~$259–330 | ~$460–470 | Stable. |
| **18 TB** | Exos X18/X20 (ST18000NM000J) | ~$670–765 | ~$580 | Stable (elevated since Oct 8). |
| **24 TB** | Exos X24 (ST24000NM002H) | ~$1,060–1,170 | ~$750–860 | Stable. |

**Structural trend (confirmed today):** HDD prices have **doubled in 2026** — AI datacenters bought the supply (HomeTechOps). **Seagate stock is up >200% YTD, WD >140%** (Yahoo Finance), and a Russian home-NAS builder reports standard 4K/6K drives **nearly doubled in a year**. Both vendors remain **booked into 2028** with **no relief expected until 2027**. The 22TB Exos refurb (~$619, $28/TB) is still the $/TB floor. ⚠️ **SATA vs SAS:** several in-stock rows are SAS — SAS won't work on a SATA-only backplane.

## Macs — your exact target configs (live 10/13)

| Machine | Config | MSRP | Best price | Availability | Δ vs Oct 12 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| **Mac mini M6** | **32 GB** / 256 GB | **$1,099** | ~$1,099 | ✅ In stock | At MSRP, not discounted |
| **Mac mini M6** | 16 GB / 256 GB (base) | $899 | **$779.99** (Amazon) | ✅ In stock | Record low, holding |
| **Mac mini M5 Pro** | **48 GB** / 512 GB | ~$1,999 | ~$1,999 | ✅ In stock | Not discounted (only base 24GB at $1,549) |
| **Mac Studio M5 Max** | **36 GB** / 512 GB | $2,499 | **$2,299** (B&H) | ✅ In stock | **Record low, holding** (−$200) |
| **Mac Studio M5 Ultra** | **96 GB** / 1 TB | $5,499 | $5,499 (B&H) | ✅ In stock | No change |
| **Mac Studio M5 Ultra** | **256 GB** | ~$9,499 (base) | BTO | ⚠️ Build-to-order | See note |

### Key developments:
- **M5 Max 36GB/512GB at $2,299 (B&H)** — your "Mac Studio M5 36GB" target — is a **record low still live** (Mazech, 10/12; osxdaily, 10/12). This is the one worth acting on.
- **M6 mini 32GB** (real config, confirmed): **$1,099** for 32GB/256GB, in stock, **not discounted** — the Prime deals only reached the 16GB base ($779.99) and M5 Pro base ($1,549).
- **M5 Pro 48GB** is a higher config (18-core CPU/20-core GPU) still at ~$1,999 — the discount didn't reach it.
- **256GB M5 Ultra:** the 96GB→256GB step adds **$4,000** (plus the $1,300 chip upgrade), so the **256GB base is ~$9,499** (256GB/1TB), scaling to **$18,299** maxed. It's **build-to-order** with long lead times.
- **512GB M5 Ultra:** confirmed for **late October 2026**, **unpriced**, expected **well above $10,000**, to be detailed at next week's event.
- **Used market:** still too early (~22 days) for a meaningful used/refurb market on the 2026 Macs. Closest "used" value remains the **M4 Pro mini 48GB** (~$1,999) and **M3 Ultra Studio 96GB** (discontinued, secondary market).

**Sources:** MacRumors (512GB M5 Ultra "late October," $200-off wave), Macworld (M5 Studio pricing/availability), Mazech (M5 Max $2,299 + 512GB event, 10/12), osxdaily (deals, 10/12), HelloExpress (M6 32GB $1,099), Apple.com (live buy pages), HomeTechOps (HDD doubled 2026), Yahoo Finance (Seagate +200% YTD, WD +140%), home-hosted.ru.

---

**Bottom line:** Little price movement today — the notable thing is that the **M5 Max 36GB/512GB at $2,299** (your "Mac Studio M5 36GB" target) is a **record low still live**, so it's the one worth acting on. The **512GB M5 Ultra is the event to watch** — Apple confirms it lands **late October**, unpriced, expected **well above $10,000**, detailed at next week's event. Your **M6 mini 32GB ($1,099)** and **M5 Pro 48GB (~$1,999)** remain at MSRP. HDDs are flat but the structural story dominates: **prices doubled in 2026, sold out through 2026, booked into 2028, no relief until 2027.**

Want me to set a price alert on the **M6 mini 32GB** and **M5 Pro 48GB** (both still at MSRP), or track the **512GB M5 Ultra** price reveal at next week's event?
